title: After the Thornwold burning, Lys's rejection line says 'Thornwold burned with him still inside it,' which reads as if her brother Cal was endangered by the fire. Cal was safe the whole time at the Scout Line/Camp Gallows muster ground, nowhere near the Gallows Glade that burned (a different location, several rooms into the deep wood). The line is misleading about what actually happened to him.
where: The Burned Glade - talking to Lys after she leaves the party
